sentences.text: Fuel with a routine every time.
Moor securely and, if practical, have passengers wait ashore.
Stop the engines and all electrical motors, and allow no smoking or open flame.
Close hatches, ports and cabin doors so vapor can’t get below.
Keep the nozzle in contact with the fill pipe to prevent a static spark, and don’t overfill, since fuel expands as it warms.
Afterward, wipe up any spills, open everything, run the blower for at least four minutes, and sniff the bilge and engine compartment before starting the engine.
